effects.description: Gives the recipient a HP Shield. All damage the recipient takes will be subtracted from the Shield first, before their HP.Each Skill can only cast one Shield at a time on each recipient.

bio: Professor Orielle rarely lectures these days – while she spent many years teaching summoning and astronomy at the Academy, she recently changed specialties. Her new love is astromancy: using the magic of the stars to blow things up. It’s a new field… and her techniques always need more testing.
